text: Use the streams and shoreline as stronger navigation cues than monster packs.
Stay on a wall and commit to the route instead of checking every branch.
The level-two waypoint is a useful orientation clue; the boss side is commonly away from it.
Search the side of Western Forest opposite the waypoint side for Weaver's Chambers.
After the first pyramid floor, staircases commonly alternate toward opposite corners.
Room size and early bust placement can help predict which sewer branch holds the remaining objective.
Recognize repeating stair rotations instead of clearing each room edge-to-edge.
Use broad directional sweeps through the open lake rather than tracing every edge.
Treat repeated edge and staircase relationships as clues, not guarantees.
Verify the next objective before committing to a sewer branch after the boss.
The Quarry is a hub. Finish required branches before committing to the core route.
